column1: # Sanctioned edits of raw files (SCHEMA §3.1, adr-0027). One line per allowed post-creation content.
# Format: <sha256 of the LF-normalised content after the edit> TAB <path under wiki/raw/> TAB <authority>.
# RAW-IMMUTABLE (npm run lint:wiki) accepts a raw-file change only when the new content hash is listed here.
# Append-only. The only sanctioned kind so far: replacing real machine values with masks (tools/mask.ps1).
